tools.name: lceda-pro.help
tools.description: ALWAYS call this FIRST when interacting with a CLI capability. Returns available subcommands, their purpose, input schemas, and usage examples. After understanding via mcli.help, use mcli.discover to find specific commands or mcli.call to execute them.

path.description: Optional command path like 'github' or 'github.issue'. Omit to see top-level.

tools.name: lceda-pro.discover
tools.description: Search for commands by keyword AFTER using mcli.help to understand the tool. Returns matching command paths and summaries. Use mcli.help first for overview, then discover to find specifics, then mcli.call to execute.

tools.name: lceda-pro.call
tools.description: Execute a registered command. Returns real data (search results, page content, etc.). Call mcli.help FIRST for overview, optionally mcli.discover to find commands, then mcli.call to fulfill user requests.
